# ONLYOFFICE Docs: Plugins — Spreadsheet API

> The Spreadsheet API lists the methods and events a plugin can use when working with a spreadsheet in ONLYOFFICE Docs. To work with the spreadsheet content directly, such as worksheets and ranges, run Office API code in callCommand. See Spreadsheet API.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. This file covers one part of the [section index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/llms.txt); for the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Spreadsheet API](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api.md): The Spreadsheet API lists the methods and events a plugin can use when working with a spreadsheet in ONLYOFFICE Docs. To work with the spreadsheet content directly, such as worksheets and ranges, run Office API code in callCommand. See Spreadsheet API.

## Methods

- [AddComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/AddComment.md): Adds a comment to the workbook.
- [AddOleObject](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/AddOleObject.md): Adds an OLE object to the current document position.
- [ChangeComment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/ChangeComment.md): Changes the specified comment.
- [CoAuthoringChatSendMessage](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/CoAuthoringChatSendMessage.md): Sends a message to the co-authoring chat.
- [EditOleObject](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/EditOleObject.md): Edits an OLE object in the document.
- [EndAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/EndAction.md): Specifies the end action for long operations.
- [FocusEditor](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/FocusEditor.md): Returns focus to the editor.
- [GetAllComments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetAllComments.md): Returns all the comments from the document.
- [GetCustomFunctions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetCustomFunctions.md): Returns a library of local custom functions.
- [GetFileToDownload](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetFileToDownload.md): Returns the current file to download in the specified format.
- [GetFontList](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetFontList.md): Returns the fonts list.
- [GetImageDataFromSelection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetImageDataFromSelection.md): Returns the image data from the first of the selected drawings.
- [GetInstalledPlugins](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetInstalledPlugins.md): Returns all the installed plugins.
- [GetMacros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetMacros.md): Returns the document macros.
- [GetRestrictions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetRestrictions.md): Returns the restrictions the editor currently applies to the document.
- [GetSelectedContent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetSelectedContent.md): Returns the selected content in the specified format.
- [GetSelectedOleObjects](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetSelectedOleObjects.md): Returns an array of the selected OLE objects.
- [GetSelectedText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetSelectedText.md): Returns the selected text from the document.
- [GetSelectionType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetSelectionType.md): Returns the type of the current selection.
- [GetVBAMacros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetVBAMacros.md): Returns all VBA macros from the document.
- [GetVersion](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/GetVersion.md): Returns the editor version.
- [InputText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/InputText.md): Inserts text into the document.
- [InstallPlugin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/InstallPlugin.md): Installs a plugin using the specified plugin config.
- [MouseMoveWindow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/MouseMoveWindow.md): Sends an event to the plugin when the mouse button is moved inside the plugin iframe.
- [MouseUpWindow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/MouseUpWindow.md): Sends an event to the plugin when the mouse button is released inside the plugin iframe.
- [OnDropEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/OnDropEvent.md): Implements the external drag&drop emulation.
- [OnEncryption](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/OnEncryption.md): Encrypts the document.
- [PasteHtml](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/PasteHtml.md): Pastes text in the HTML format into the document.
- [PasteText](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/PasteText.md): Pastes text into the document.
- [PutImageDataToSelection](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/PutImageDataToSelection.md): Replaces the first selected drawing with the image specified in the parameters.
- [RemoveComments](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/RemoveComments.md): Removes the specified comments.
- [RemoveOleObject](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/RemoveOleObject.md): Removes the OLE object from the workbook by its internal ID.
- [RemovePlugin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/RemovePlugin.md): Removes a plugin with the specified GUID.
- [ReplaceTextSmart](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/ReplaceTextSmart.md): Replaces each paragraph (or text in cell) in the select with the corresponding text from an array of strings.
- [SetButtonDisabled](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/SetButtonDisabled.md): Enables or disables the modal plugin footer button by index.
- [SetCustomFunctions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/SetCustomFunctions.md): Updates a library of local custom functions.
- [SetMacros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/SetMacros.md): Sets macros to the document.
- [SetPluginsOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/SetPluginsOptions.md): Configures plugins from an external source.
- [SetProperties](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/SetProperties.md): Sets the properties to the document.
- [ShowButton](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/ShowButton.md): Shows or hides buttons in the header.
- [ShowError](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/ShowError.md): Shows an error/warning message.
- [ShowInputHelper](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/ShowInputHelper.md): Shows the input helper.
- [StartAction](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/StartAction.md): Specifies the start action for long operations.
- [UnShowInputHelper](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/UnShowInputHelper.md): Unshows the input helper.
- [UpdatePlugin](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Methods/UpdatePlugin.md): Updates a plugin using the specified plugin config.

## Events

- [onChangeCurrentSheet](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onChangeCurrentSheet.md): The function called when the current sheet has changed.
- [onChangeRestrictions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onChangeRestrictions.md): The function called when the restrictions in the editor are changed.
- [onClick](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onClick.md): The function called when the user clicks the element.
- [onDocumentContentReady](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onDocumentContentReady.md): The function called when the document is completely loaded.
- [onEnableMouseEvent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onEnableMouseEvent.md): The function called to turn the mouse or touchpad events on/off.
- [onExternalMouseUp](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onExternalMouseUp.md): The function called when the mouse button is released outside the plugin iframe.
- [onFloatActionButtonClick](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onFloatActionButtonClick.md): The function called when the floating action button has been clicked.
- [onTargetPositionChanged](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Events/onTargetPositionChanged.md): The function called when the target position in the editor is changed.

## Enumeration

- [CommentData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/CommentData.md): The comment data.
- [EditorRestrictions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/EditorRestrictions.md): The current editing restrictions, a combination of the flags: 0x00 - no editing restrictions, 0x01 - allows editing form fields, 0x02 - allows editing comments and regions delimited by range permissions, 0x04 - the document is signed and cannot be changed, 0x80 - does not allow editing.
- [FontInfo](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/FontInfo.md): An object containing the font information.
- [ImageData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/ImageData.md): An object containing the information about the base64 encoded png image.
- [Macros](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/Macros.md): An object containing the data about all the macros from the document.
- [OLEProperties](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/OLEProperties.md): The OLE object properties
- [PluginData](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/PluginData.md): The plugin object.
- [PluginOptions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/PluginOptions.md): The plugin options.
- [ReplaceImageMode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/ReplaceImageMode.md): Specifies how to adjust the image object in case of replacing the selected image.
- [SelectionType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/SelectionType.md): The current selection type ("none", "text", "drawing", or "slide").
- [ShapeType](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/ShapeType.md): This type specifies the preset shape geometry that will be used for a shape.
- [comment](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/comment.md): Comment object.
- [fillForms](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/fillForms.md): An object containing the form properties.
- [watermark_on_draw](https://api.onlyoffice.com/ai-plugin-docs-update/docs/plugins/interacting-with-editors/spreadsheet-api/Enumeration/watermark_on_draw.md): An object containing the watermark properties.
